verdict.rationale: GitLab's Duo Agent Platform documents natural-language operation. Chat answers queries like "Find the merge request about authentication" and has persistent context across issues, MRs, commits and pipelines. Agents turn issues into MRs and take delegated tasks, chat-based agent sessions carry human-in-the-loop approvals, and an official MCP server lets external agents drive GitLab. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that NL commands work reliably, and evidence on how far chat can perform actions (e.g. admin/config changes) beyond search and delegated agent tasks, since the docs are mostly snippet-level.
